page.layout: One block of centred title text, framed above and below by woodcut ornament borders. Top: floral border (ornament only). Middle: three title lines, a rule, and the date line. Bottom: grotesque border (ornament only). No running head, page number, or other text.
page.notes: Two woodcut ornament borders, one floral above the title and one grotesque with masks and pendants below it, carry no text. The date line is printed with reversed-C numerals, cIↄIↄCXX, which is MDCXX (1620). The "Digitized by Google" watermark in the lower right is excluded. Small specks and marks on the scan are not printed text.
